Behind the image
43 / Brocade Avenue
REFERENCE 5800.JPG / EDITORIAL PAGE 033
Art direction: 1990s gothic-romantic street style, black velvet and antique gold, golden-hour
autumn city.
Cinematic vertical full-length street portrait of an original adult woman with long straight
copper-red hair and bold red lips, walking on an autumn city street with black iron railings, stone
steps and fallen leaves. She wears a black velvet longline coat over a lace-collared top with long
pearl chains and a floor-length gold-and-black brocade skirt with a ragged hem. Golden-hour light,
1990s gothic-romantic mood, black and antique-gold palette, subtle film grain, no text or logos.
44 / Office Gold
REFERENCE 5799.JPG / EDITORIAL PAGE 034
Art direction: Nostalgic late-90s workplace glamour, warm tungsten office light, black and gold
sparkle, cinematic film still.
Cinematic vertical 1990s office film still of an original adult woman with straight brown hair and a
center part, seated at an old wooden desk beside a beige CRT computer. She wears a black lace
high-neck top under a gold-flecked sequin mini dress, a black velvet blazer and glossy black
knee-high boots, with a candid, slightly distracted expression. Warm tungsten office light,
nostalgic late-90s glamour, black and gold sparkle, film grain, no text or logos.
